description: The NAVSUP Fleet Logistics Center (FLC) Yokosuka Site Sasebo intends to issue a competitive solicitation for LPD-22, ICN 38DX223334_00_A01, Description 2B MPDE OVERSPEED GOVERNOR ASSY; OVERHAUL to Master Ship Repair Agreement (MSRA) and capable Agreement for Boat Repair (ABR) holders in Japan only.
